strengths: The paper frames AIRTOS as runtime governance between qualified plans and hardware rather than as a new EDF algorithm or RTOS kernel.
The all-job admission ablation and WCET sensitivity experiment directly support the principal timing argument.
Physical coherency uses observable omission controls and keeps its hardware scope precise.
The four figures are integrated into the design and evaluation narrative.
weaknesses: The package contract fields and their enforcement points are distributed across prose, making the consumer-side boundary slower to audit.
The safety-properties subsection states lease, DAG, epoch, coherency, and deadline properties but does not state atomic publication and recovery closure with the same precision.
Software-model consistency, physical data-path evidence, controlled board state-machine injection, and short continuous operation should be summarized in one evidence-layer table.
questions: What exact linearization point ensures that an admitted job cannot be published without its lease?
Which runtime check consumes each major field of the evidence-carrying plan?
Which experimental layer supports each class of statement?
